Package org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockBlockType

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockBlockType
public final class BedrockBlockType extends Object
A Bedrock block type: an identifier with its state properties. Vanilla types are the constants of BedrockBlocks; a CustomBlock has one too (CustomBlock.type()), so both are used alike: 

 BedrockBlockState door = BedrockBlocks.WOODEN_DOOR.state()
     .with(BedrockStates.CARDINAL_DIRECTION, CardinalDirection.NORTH)
     .with(BedrockStates.OPEN_BIT, true)
     .build();
 int runtimeId = palette.runtimeId(door);
Referencing a type loads nothing; its states are resolved against the newest data of Paletter.bundled() on first use. A vanilla constant the data does not have (deprecated because Bedrock removed the block, or a preview block without the preview loaded) is not available: its states are those of its fallback, normally minecraft:unknown.
Since:
1.0.0
